crates/kungfu-cli/src/main.rs.purpose: clap CLI entrypoint: command enum, argument parsing, dispatch into commands.rs

crates/kungfu-config/src/lib.rs.purpose: KungfuConfig: the single validated entry point for TOML config loading and merging ([index], [call_graph], watch)

crates/kungfu-core/src/helpers.rs.purpose: Shared retrieval helpers: test-symbol detection, primary-language detection, symbol lookup utilities

crates/kungfu-core/src/lib.rs.purpose: KungfuService slim facade: constructor, accessors, budget resolution, ensure_fresh_index; use cases live in the sibling modules

crates/kungfu-core/src/types.rs.purpose: Response DTOs for core use cases: StatusInfo, RepoOutline, FileOutline, OnboardInfo and friends

crates/kungfu-mcp/src/params.rs.purpose: Input parameter structs for every MCP tool; schemars derives the tool JSON schemas from these

crates/kungfu-project/src/lib.rs.purpose: Project root detection and .kungfu directory management: init, meta, config paths, Claude Code integration entry

crates/kungfu-rank/src/lib.rs.purpose: Context packet assembly: greedy marginal-relevance selection (MMR), same-file decay, dedup, budget trim

terms.mmr: greedy marginal-relevance pass replacing pure top-K so one file cannot flood the packet

crates/kungfu-storage/src/lib.rs.purpose: JsonStore: atomic JSON persistence of index shards (files/symbols/relations/memories), schema versioning, process-cache glue

crates/kungfu-types/src/budget.rs.purpose: Budget levels (tiny/small/medium/full) that cap every retrieval path end-to-end

terms.budget: hard cap on packet size threaded through all retrieval

crates/kungfu-types/src/context.rs.purpose: ContextPacket response shape: scored items, rationale, evidence, retrieval honesty fields — what every retrieval use case returns

crates/kungfu-types/src/file.rs.purpose: FileEntry domain type (hash, language, tags, purpose with provenance) and the Language enum with extension mapping

crates/kungfu-types/src/lib.rs.purpose: Root of the shared domain-types crate: re-exports Budget, FileEntry, Symbol, Relation, ContextPacket — the contract every other crate builds on

crates/kungfu-types/src/memory.rs.purpose: Memory domain types: auto-extracted MemoryEntry (comments/docs) and manual ProjectMemoryEntry with kind/status/pinning

crates/kungfu-types/src/relation.rs.purpose: Relation edge type (imports and calls graphs) plus CallGraphMeta describing build-time noise filtering

terms.relation: one edge in the import or call graph between files/symbols

crates/kungfu-types/src/symbol.rs.purpose: Symbol domain type: SymbolKind taxonomy, Span coordinates, doc_summary — the unit every search and ranking path operates on

terms.symbol: one named code entity (fn/struct/class/...) extracted by tree-sitter
